text: The early force transient (margin 0.12-0.19 at steps 10-30, fading to about 0 by step 80-110) looks the same at N=256 as the one reported at N=64, even though N=256 never beats the constant-velocity baseline. Is this transient independent of steps_per_orbit and of task success? Would it also appear in a model trained on shuffled-time sequences?
